name: devcat-promo
description: README screenshots (capture the demo-mode UI); film/ turns them into the README GIF and the social video with HyperFrames.

scripts.stills: mkdir -p ../assets/readme && for f in ai diff table query git k8s network notes agent bots ghost memory welcome; do sips -Z 1600 public/shots/$f.png --out ../assets/readme/$f.png >/dev/null; done
scripts.film: cd film && npx --yes hyperframes@0.8.221 render -c ./readme.html -o out/devcat-readme.mp4 && npx --yes hyperframes@0.8.221 render -o out/devcat-social.mp4
